files.content: "use client" import * as React from "react" import { format } from "date-fns" import { Icon } from "@iconify/react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { formFieldBase, formFieldSingleLine } from "./_shared" import { Calendar } from "./calendar" import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from "./popover" /* * Bevel DatePicker. * * The trigger is a form field, not a button, so a date sits in a stacked form * on the same pressed well as the inputs above and below it. Tapping it opens * the month grid on the popover surface: no border, the 14px radius and the * deeper drop shadow, so the sheet separates from the card it opens over. */ /** Props for `DatePicker`, a single-date field with a calendar popover. */ export interface DatePickerProps { value?: Date onValueChange?: (date: Date | undefined) => void placeholder?: string className?: string disabled?: boolean } const DatePicker = React.forwardRef( ( { value, onValueChange, placeholder = "Pick a date", className, disabled }, ref, ) => ( ), ) DatePicker.displayName = "DatePicker" export { DatePicker }
